base_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE background scene for a cozy movie discovery prototype. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match their rich hand-painted gouache, thick visible brush marks, luminous amber light pooling on warm wood, layered intimate lived-in detail, deep midnight blue walls and rainy night windows. NOT a 3D render or photorealism, not sparse or flat. Change their layout and remove ALL candles, lanterns, tea lights, TV, green screens, wall poster frames, plaid blankets and repeated props. Natural human-sized furniture, each furniture piece under 45% of image width. Full but tidy room, nothing loose on floor. Two to four different fabric cushions total, at most one plain throw, two different plant species maximum in muted olive tones; varied books, unique ceramics, one framed photo in shelves, no duplicated ornaments. Lamps electric with shades, fairy lights hugging shelf edges only. Full-height warm wooden bookcases at BOTH outer edges with EXACTLY TWELVE clearly separated face-out portrait cases, SIX on each edge. Each flat face pure uniform #FF00FF, about 0.75 width to height, minimum 45px short side, with wooden shelf gaps separating every case. Slots only on side shelves, unobstructed. Nothing else green or magenta. NO text readable titles logos watermarks or people. Sleeping golden retriever prominent and fully visible in y .45-.72. Rich woven rug fills lower foreground for results card, little bare floor. Main upper wall completely plain blue paint for UI; no objects hanging into calm zone.
composition_constraints: undefined Window, alcove and curtain top at y .40 or LOWER; wall MUST stay blank through y .33. Do not place matching ferns on opposite shelves: exactly ONE fern on left shelf, ONE rubber plant by chair, no third plant. Use plain solid pottery, each vessel unique color and shape; never repeat blue-white dotted pottery.

room_prompts.armchair: Left: one-window-wide cushioned window seat under rainy window with golden dog asleep across seat, x .19-.52 y .54-.69. Right: comfortable reading armchair angled inward with modest ottoman and warm shaded floor lamp beside it, reachable small round side table with one mug. One rust velvet and one floral linen cushion on seat, one textured cream cushion in chair, single ochre throw on chair. Diverse ceramic objects and books fill shelves.
room_prompts.tea: Intimate tea nook: small ROUND wooden table (about 28% image width) with one ceramic teapot and exactly two cups. Two mismatched normal chairs, one bentwood, one upholstered; low rainy window behind table. Tabletop near y .48, dog curled asleep on a thick oval wool dog cushion beneath table at y .57-.70, fully visible between slender legs, table's pedestal offset so no leg crosses dog's face. A shaded electric table lamp on a tiny side cabinet casts warm pools. Three different cushions on chairs/window recess total. Shelf detail dense and varied.
room_prompts.corner: Intimate corner reading alcove: normal single-window-wide recessed window seat (maximum 40% image width) with curtains tucked to either side and rainy glass; warm shaded wall lamp INSIDE alcove below calm zone. Sleeping golden dog on cushioned seat at y .54-.68, fully visible. Three cushions in different fabrics (rust velvet, ochre linen, tiny blue floral), one plain cream knitted throw folded on seat end. Small reachable side table with a mug, one low narrow cabinet with a ceramic bowl and framed photo; full tidy shelves and warm layered woodwork.
